text.title: Siberian flying squirrel
text.menu_sub: Climb a tree, then hold Jump and steer to glide.
text.menu_wild: Watch for predators. Climb and glide to safety.
text.intro_safe: Climb a trunk, then hold Jump and steer away to glide. You lose height as you glide.
text.intro_survival: Find leaves and buds to eat. Climb trees and glide between them.
text.intro_wild: Stay near trees. Climb to safety and glide away from danger.
text.night_hint: It's night. Run at a spruce trunk to climb it, then sleep in its thick branches.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to sleep! Climb a spruce and curl up in its thick branches.
text.sheltered: You're curled up safe and warm in the spruce branches.
text.hungry: Look for leaves and buds on young trees.
text.no_food: No leaves or buds within reach. Look for young trees.
text.rain_start: It's starting to rain. Climb into a spruce's thick branches to stay warm.
text.chased: A fox is chasing you! Run up a tree!
text.about_looks: Soft grey fur, a white belly, large dark eyes and a flat tail. A skin membrane stretches between its front and back legs.
text.about_food: Leaves in summer; buds and birch and alder catkins in winter.
text.about_home: Lives in tree holes and sometimes old squirrel dreys in mixed forests.
text.about_winter: Stays active through winter and stores catkins for food.
text.about_young: The mother raises her young in a tree nest in spring, sometimes with a second litter in summer.
text.about_fact: It glides using skin stretched between its legs. It cannot flap or fly upwards.

year.shelter: Tree holes, nest boxes and dreys. Tree crowns approximate shelter in the current game.
year.young: Mother raises young in spring; sometimes a second summer litter.

food.spring: Buds and birch and alder catkins.
food.autumn: Leaves, buds and catkins; stores catkins.
food.winter: Birch and alder catkins and tree buds.

year.notes: Nocturnal. Glides downwards between trees. Current browse food represents leaves and buds; stored catkins and nest cavities are not yet simulated.
